2. Most people performing push-ups: The record is 2,926 people performing push-ups achieved by the United States Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs, USA, on 20 April 2023. Cadets performed push-ups on the USAFA's Terrazzo, a plaza in the middle of the campus.

3. Most 180 push-ups in one minute (male): The record is 23 180 push-ups in one minute achieved by Alex Goulding from the United Kingdom in London on 5 May 2023. Alex is an advocate for mental health awareness and a multiple record holder in the discipline of push-ups.
